## Explore the AI model {style="text-align:center;"}

::: {.model-intro}
The app uses a convolutional neural network (CNN) for fruit detection and segmentation, combined with geometric calibration using a reference marker.
:::

::: {.model-columns}

::: {}
**Pipeline:** Calibrate → Capture → Detect → Measure

## Run inference mode Fruit

```bash
python main.py --mode Fruit --image example_images/IMG_20240828_122454.jpg
```

## Run inference mode Cluster

```bash
python main.py --mode Cluster --image example_images/IMG_20240828_122454.jpg
```
:::

::: {}

## Optional Arguments

::: {.code-tag}
--dist_fruit2cam
:::

Distance (mm) from fruit to camera (default: 250 mm)

## Output

::: {.output-row}
[*_results.csv]{.code-tag} → The diameter plus the confidence
:::
::: {.output-row}
[*_mask_dets.jpg]{.code-tag} → Segmentation
:::
::: {.output-row}
[*_bb_dets.jpg]{.code-tag} → Create the bounding boxes
:::

:::
